skintotems.options.title: Skin Totems
skintotems.options.style.tooltip:
Totem: flat totem in the Custom Totem Generator style.
Plushie: a small 3D plushie of the player.
skintotems.options.show_others.tooltip: Totems held by other players show their skin.
skintotems.options.show_own_hand.tooltip: Your held totem (first and third person) shows your skin.
skintotems.options.show_inventory.toolti: Totems in your hotbar and inventory show your skin.
skintotems.options.show_activation.toolt: The big totem pop animation shows your skin.
skintotems.options.totem_hat.tooltip: Draw the second skin layer (hat, hair) over the head.
skintotems.options.totem_outline.tooltip: Draw a dark outline around the totem.
skintotems.options.plushie_outer_layer.t: Show the second skin layer (hat, jacket, sleeves, pants) on the plushie.
skintotems.options.plushie_size.tooltip: Plushie size everywhere it is shown.
